description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession class, specifically testing the 'containsKey' method to verify if it correctly identifies the presence or absence of a key based on its key ID. It defines a test fixture class and two test cases.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionContainsKeyTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase, used to set up the environment for testing the 'containsKey' method.

methods.name: ReturnTrue
methods.description: Test case verifying that 'containsKey' returns true when the key ID is present.

methods.name: ReturnFalse
methods.description: Test case verifying that 'containsKey' returns false when the key ID is not present.
